Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
Concordance
Action
Daimonion/Serpentis
1 blood
+1 stealth action.
[ser]: Bleed. If more than 1 pool is bled with this action, ignore the
excess.
[dai]: Requires an infernal vampire. Put this card on the acting vampire.
This vampire treats aggravated damage as normal damage and has +1 strength
and -1 stealth.
<DAI>: As [dai] above, and this vampire has flight and may burn 1 blood
to untap during your influence phase.

Haven't seen this card myself, just quoting a spoiler that was put up. It
seems like this card is stackable, is this true?

Roger

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Roger Carhult wrote:
> Haven't seen this card myself, just quoting a spoiler that was put up. It
> seems like this card is stackable, is this true?

Yes.
All cards are stackable by default.
Explicit card text is needed to change that.

--

the Infernal cost if you want to use the infernal minion during your
turn.

If you want to do a bleed action it does. You're going to pay at least 1
pool to get the Concordance action through though. You could reduce the
damage potential by using stealth instead of DtD and if you do get blocked
you can Change of Target and untap, leaving you free to block or take
another action. There's also Freak Drive.
